title: End To End Eval Runner
motto: Five lessons of plumbing, one lesson to glue them. The runner reads the task spec from lesson 70, calls a model through an adapter, scores with lessons 71 and 72, attaches the calibration report from lesson 73, and emits the leaderboard from lesson 74. Demo self-terminates.
